barren_no_spray: No pre-emergence spray on bare soil this close to sowing unless needed for weeds/stubble.
barren_spray_rain_delay: Rain forecast — delay herbicide/stubble treatment until the field is dry.
barren_spray_consider: Consider weed/stubble management on barren field before sowing (not crop foliar spray).
barren_spray_hint: If heavy weeds or stubble: use recommended pre-sowing herbicide or remove mechanically. Avoid spray within 48 hours of expected rain.
barren_fert_plan: Basal fertilizer is applied at or just before sowing. Prepare quantities for planned {crop}.
barren_fert_active: Sowing window active — prepare and apply basal dose for {crop}.
barren_irr_ok: Soil moisture adequate for land prep. Avoid waterlogging before sowing.
barren_irr_dry_optional: Soil moisture low but not yet sowing week — light irrigation optional before final tillage.
barren_irr_pre_sowing_only: Pre-sowing irrigation only if seedbed is dry at sowing depth.
barren_irr_rain_hold: Rain expected this week — do not irrigate until drainage is confirmed.
barren_irr_dry_sow: Soil is dry ahead of sowing — light pre-sowing irrigation to bring moisture to seed depth.
barren_irr_light: One light irrigation 2–4 days before sowing (or soak if furrow sowing). Stop if rain is forecast.
barren_monitoring: Check weed pressure, soil moisture at 10–15 cm, and field levelness. Update expected sowing date after sowing.
barren_sowing_passed: Expected sowing date has passed. Reassess soil moisture and variety window before sowing.
barren_heavy_rain: Heavy rain expected in the next 3 days. Delay final land prep and sowing until topsoil drains.
barren_heat: Very high temperatures forecast. Prefer evening sowing or wait for a cooler spell.
barren_rain_sowing_week: Moderate rain near sowing week. Complete primary tillage now; sow after rain clears.
barren_dry_window: Relatively dry window ahead — good for land leveling, final tillage, and basal fertilizer incorporation.
barren_monitor_weekly: Monitor forecast weekly. Complete deep ploughing and residue management before the sowing week.
weather_days_note_overdue: Sowing date was {days} day(s) ago — update or sow soon.
crop_risk_action_high: Scout field within 24 hours; address irrigation and nutrition first.
carbon_note_organic: Before sowing: add compost/FYM to improve organic matter and long-term carbon capture.
carbon_note_conventional: Plan residue retention and efficient fertilizer use from the first crop cycle.
plant_growth_description: No standing crop. Preparing for {crop} ({variety}). Expected sowing: {date}.
crop_health_recommendation: Barren field — no crop in ground. Follow pre-sowing checklist for {crop}. {reason}
yield_explanation: Standard yield = crop profile benchmark (per hectare) x farm area. AI yield adjusts that using growth, health, greenness, water, and nutrients.
yield_explanation_short: Standard = crop profile benchmark × farm area. AI adjusts using growth, health, temperature, water, and soil fertility.
yield_skipped_maturity: Yield estimate is shown only at maturity/harvest stage.
yield_skipped_barren: Yield estimate is shown only after the crop is sown.
crop_weather_heavy_rain: Heavy rain expected in the next 3 days (~{rain3} mm) — delay spray and adjust irrigation.
crop_weather_light_rain: Light to moderate rain in the next 3 days (~{rain3} mm).
crop_weather_dry_week: Dry week ahead — plan irrigation per schedule.
crop_weather_clear: No major rain risk in the next few days.
crop_risk_action_moderate: Monitor stressed zones; confirm irrigation and leaf color.
crop_monitor_default: Check {checks}. Repeat every 3–4 days or after rain.
crop_carbon_unavailable: Carbon data not available for this cycle.
crop_carbon_positive: Net carbon positive for the farm — maintain residue and organic matter.
crop_carbon_negative: Higher emissions than capture — consider efficient irrigation and balanced fertilizer.
crop_carbon_message: Estimated emissions {emission} kg CO₂, capture {capture} kg CO₂. Net {net} kg CO₂. {note}
harvest_reduce_irr: Reduce irrigation before harvest unless soil is very dry.
decision_organic_no_spray: Organic farm — no chemical spray. Use neem oil or approved biopesticides.
decision_wind_rain_no_spray: Wind is high or rain is expected. Skip spray today.
decision_stable_no_spray: Crop health is stable. No spray needed today.
decision_stress_spray: Crop stress or sensitive stage. Consider preventive spray.
decision_spray_choose: Choose one product based on observed pest or disease and label guidance.
decision_npk_missing: NPK data is missing. Verify soil or fertilizer records before fertigation.
decision_no_fert_window: No fertigation window for the current growth stage.
decision_nutrients_balanced: Nutrients are balanced. No fertigation needed today.
decision_organic_fert: Organic farm: use only organic inputs.
decision_inorganic_fert: Inorganic farm: apply chemical fertilizer per nutrient deficit.
decision_integrated_fert: Integrated farm: combine organic and chemical inputs per schedule.
decision_irrigation_drip: Run drip or sprinkler for {minutes} minutes.
detail_monitor_checks: lower leaves, stem base, new growth, soil moisture
health_recommendation_excellent: The crop is very healthy. Continue the current farming practices.
health_recommendation_good: Crop health is good. Ensure timely irrigation and regular care.
health_recommendation_moderate: The crop is under mild stress. Review irrigation and nutrient management.
health_recommendation_poor: Crop stress detected. Immediate corrective action is required.
health_recommendation_critical: Severe crop stress detected. Urgent intervention is required.
npk_barren_land:
Crop: {cropName}
Growth stage: {stageName}
Area: {areaAcre} acres

No standing crop in the field (barren / fallow).
Planned crop: {cropName} — prepare basal fertilizer before sowing.
Apply well-decomposed FYM/compost (integrated/organic farms) and DAP/SSP/Urea/MOP per soil test.
Incorporate 1–3 days before sowing or at sowing in the seedbed.
Light irrigation if needed; avoid waterlogging.
npk_ui_growth_subtitle: Day {cropAgeDays} · NPK targets match this stage
npk_ui_zero_baseline_body: Current and target NPK values are at baseline (0 kg/ha). This can happen post-harvest or when nutrient recommendations are not yet computed.
npk_ui_card_planning_body: Prepare nutrient plan for next crop cycle
npk_ui_recommendation_fallback: Run a fresh soil test and satellite refresh for this field, then apply a stage-wise NPK plan based on crop age and expected yield.
fert_method_after_validation: Apply only after the NPK data is verified
fert_time_next_stage: Current stage BBCH {bbch}. Follow the next scheduled stage.
fert_step_split_50: Split the dose if the total is more than 50 kg/acre
spray_method_canopy: Foliar spray covering the whole canopy evenly
spray_timing_low_wind: Early morning or late evening when wind is low
spray_note_one_option: Use one product at a time; do not tank-mix without compatibility guidance.
spray_note_label: Follow the label's waiting periods before harvest and field re-entry, and local agronomy advice.
spray_note_ppe: Wear protective gear and avoid spraying in peak heat.
monitor_checks_stress_zone: leaves, pest damage, irrigation, nutrient deficiency
monitor_checks_pressure: lower leaves, pests, fungal spots, irrigation
irr_reason_no_moisture_data: Soil moisture readings are unavailable. Check field moisture before deciding how long to irrigate.
irr_reason_rain_skip: Rain expected (more than 10 mm). Skip irrigation today.
irr_reason_moisture_ok: Soil moisture is adequate. No irrigation needed today.
irr_reason_apply_minutes: Apply {mm} mm every {days} days for {duration} minutes ({lmin} L/min, ~{m3} m³ total).
irr_reason_apply_hours: Apply {mm} mm every {days} days for {duration} hours ({lmin} L/min, ~{m3} m³ total).
barren_hint_fert_plan: Plan the basal dose (DAP/Urea/MOP or FYM)
barren_hint_time_plan: 1–3 days before sowing or at sowing
barren_hint_qty_basal: Full basal dose for {acre} acre at sowing; split it if the soil is heavy
barren_hint_time_basal: At sowing or 1 day before, with light irrigation
barren_hint_method_basal: Broadcast and mix into the seedbed, or place in a band below the seed
barren_dose_soil_test: As per soil test and crop schedule
barren_spray_product: As per local extension advice and weed type
barren_spray_method: Spray on weed leaves, or remove weeds mechanically
barren_spray_timing: Morning, wind below 10 km/h, 5–7 days before sowing if using a chemical
rk_spray_none: No pest or disease risk from the weather. No spray needed today.
rk_spray_no_weather: Weather data is incomplete, so spray risk could not be checked. Inspect the crop before spraying.
rk_spray_indoor: Indoor crop - no field spray advice.
rk_spray_wait: High risk of {pest}, but {blocker}. Spray {product} at {dose} on {date}.
rk_spray_wait_nodate: High risk of {pest}, but {blocker}. Spray {product} at {dose} on the next dry, calm day.
rk_spray_monitor: Risk of {pest} is rising. Inspect the field in the next 2 days; spray only if you see it.
rk_spray_monitor_product: Risk of {pest} is rising. Inspect the field in the next 2 days. If you see it, spray {product} at {dose}.
rk_spray_recent: {pest}: sprayed on {date}. No repeat spray needed now - keep watching.
rk_spray_consult: High risk of {pest}. No registered product in our list for your country - follow the local label or your agronomist.
rk_spray_harvest: Risk of {pest}, but the crop is near harvest. Do not use chemical sprays now.
rk_time_spray_morning: early morning when there is no wind
rk_irr_indoor: Indoor crop - keep room humidity at 80-90%.
rk_irr_skip_rain: Rain expected today (~{rain} mm). Do not irrigate.
rk_irr_drain: Heavy rain (~{rain} mm in 3 days). Open field drainage and do not irrigate for 3 days.
rk_irr_stop_harvest: Crop is near harvest. Stop irrigation now.
rk_irr_drip_plant: Run drip for {minutes} min {timing} (~{litres} L per plant).
rk_irr_flood: Give one irrigation of about {mm} mm {timing}.
rk_irr_flood_hours: Give one irrigation of about {mm} mm (~{hours} h with your pump) {timing}.
rk_irr_critical_suffix: Crop is at a critical stage - do not let it suffer water stress.
rk_irr_protective: Soil is dry at a critical stage. If you have water, give one protective irrigation (~{mm} mm).
rk_irr_conserve: Soil is drying. Save moisture: mulch and do light hoeing.
rk_irr_postpone: Soil is drying, but about {rain} mm rain is expected in 2 days. Wait for the rain.
rk_irr_light_heat: Very hot day ({tmax}°C). Give a light irrigation in the evening.
rk_irr_light_frost: Frost risk tonight ({tmin}°C). Give a light irrigation in the evening.
rk_irr_check: Soil moisture data is not available. Check by hand: irrigate if a soil ball from root depth crumbles.
rk_irr_none: Soil moisture is enough. Next irrigation in about {days} days.
rk_irr_rainfed_ok: Rainfed field: soil moisture is fine for now.
rk_time_irr_night: at night or early morning (windy day)
rk_fert_already: Fertilizer for this stage was applied on {date}. No repeat needed.
rk_alert_heavy_rain: Heavy rain expected (~{rain} mm). Stop spraying and irrigation; open field drainage.
rk_alert_heat: Very hot weather ({tmax}°C). Irrigate in the evening; do not spray at midday.
rk_alert_frost: Frost risk tonight ({tmin}°C). Give a light irrigation in the evening.
rk_alert_wind: Strong wind ({wind} km/h). Do not spray; support tall plants.
rk_alert_dry_spell: No rain for {days} days. Save soil moisture: mulch and light hoeing; irrigate if you can.
rk_alert_pest: High risk of {pest} in the coming days. Recommended: {product} {dose}.
rk_alert_waterlog: Water may stand in the field (~{rain} mm in 3 days). Drain within 24 hours to save the roots.
rk_alert_sat_stress: Crop looks weaker in part of your field. Check for pests, water or nutrient problems.
rk_irr_split_suffix: Run time is long - split it over 2 days.
mon_veg_drop: Crop vigour fell {pct}% since {date}. Likely cause: {cause}. Walk the field and check the weak patch.
mon_veg_low: Crop is weaker than normal for this stage (NDVI {value}, expected about {expected}). Likely cause: {cause}.
mon_water: Satellite shows the crop is short of water. {action}
mon_nitrogen: Leaf greenness is falling while growth is steady - possible nitrogen shortage. Check leaf colour and apply the due fertilizer dose.
mon_waterlog: Radar shows standing water in your field. Open drainage within 24 hours to save the roots.
mon_canopy_loss: Radar shows a sudden change in the crop - lodging, damage or harvest? Please check and tell us what happened.
mon_stage: Your crop has reached the {stage} stage.
mon_stage_critical: This is a critical stage - do not let it lack water or nutrients.
mon_delay: Crop is growing slower than expected for the weather so far. Likely cause: {cause}.
mon_irr_critical: Crop is at a critical stage and the soil is drying. {action}
mon_overdue: Spray for {pest} was advised on {date} and is not marked done. Risk is still high.
mon_no_scene: No clear satellite image for {days} days (clouds). Please check the crop in person.
mon_cause_unknown: not clear from data - please inspect
mon_more_in_app: +{n} more alert(s) in the CropGen app.
rk_irr_drip_maintain: Normal drip run today: {minutes} min {timing} (~{mm} mm).
mon_water_check_system: Soil water looks enough on paper, so check that water reaches every plant (blocked drippers, uneven flow, leaks).
